record.question: Antonym of ENERVATE:
record.explanation:
Enervate means to weaken, drain energy, or make someone feel exhausted.

Invigorate means to strengthen, energize, or give renewed vitality.

A. Weaken — Synonym

B. Exhaust — Synonym

C. Invigorate — Antonym ✅

D. Comfort — Not a direct antonym
